description: Figure 3 is a line chart titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset” that illustrates how three evaluation metrics (precision, recall, and F1-score) vary across five MS-FSLHate model variants. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” on a categorical (non-numeric) scale with five tick labels: “Full model (ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” on a linear scale spanning approximately 56 to 66, with evenly spaced tick marks at 58, 60, 62, 64, and 66 (percent). Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: a purple Precision line that starts at 65.45 for the full model, drops to 61.06 at w/o Prompt, rises to 62.22 at w/o Augmentation, increases to 64.06 at w/o Attention, and ends at 65.44 at w/o Prompt & Augmentation; a blue Recall line that starts at 65.78, drops to 59.64, rises to 63.75, drops to 59.17, and ends at 56.82; and a tan/brown F1-score line that starts at 65.56, drops to 60.16, rises to 62.63, drops to 59.67, and ends at 57.74.
